body_html:
The Craft Curve-120 Degree Unit turns an open floorplan into a destination. This fully upholstered, 120-degree modular lounge piece curves into pods, waves, and full circles, giving you a durable, design-forward way to shape collaborative seating in lobbies, breakout areas, and open offices. Non-handed and endlessly reconfigurable, it works alone or alongside the rest of the Offices To Go Craft seating and table series.

Features

  • Modular non-handed components that fully reconfigure — ideal for open spaces
  • 120-degree curved geometry for unique, near-infinite layout possibilities
  • Fully upholstered construction built for high-traffic institutional use
  • Standard 1.5" tall nylon glides; optional dual-wheel casters for carpet (C107) or hard floor (C107R)
  • Available in all grade 1 seating textiles, LuxPlus, and graded-in or GPM textiles
  • GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low-emission indoor air quality

Specifications

Overall dimensions 43.5"W x 27.5"D x 17.5"H with a 17.5" seat height; weighs 37 lbs. Proudly made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and backed by a 5-year warranty, with 15 years on the metal frame.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your Craft configuration.
